006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.HexBinaryItem;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.IBinaryItem;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
014
015import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
016
017import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
018
019/**
020 * An atomic Metapath item containing a Base64 encoded data value.
021 */
022public interface IHexBinaryItem extends IBinaryItem {
023  /**
024   * Get the type information for this item.
025   *
026   * @return the type information
027   */
028  @NonNull
029  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IHexBinaryItem> type() {
030    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.HEX_BINARY.getItemType();
031  }
032
033  @Override
034  default IAtomicOrUnionType<IHexBinaryItem> getType() {
035    return type();
036  }
037
038  /**
039   * Construct a new base64 byte sequence item using the provided base64 encoded
040   * string {@code value}.
041   *
042   * @param value
043   *          a string representing base64 encoded data
044   * @return the new item
045   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
046   *           if the provided string is not a valid Base64 character sequence
047   */
048  @NonNull
049  static IHexBinaryItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
050    try {
051      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.BASE64.parse(value));
052    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
053      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
054          null,
055          String.format("The value starting with '%s' is not a valid hex encoded character sequence. %s",
056              value.substring(0, Math.min(value.length(), 200)),
057              ex.getLocalizedMessage()),
058          ex);
059    }
060  }
061
062  /**
063   * Construct a new URI base64 encoded byte sequence using the provided
064   * {@link ByteBuffer} {@code value}.
065   * <p>
066   * The provided buffer will be managed by this instance. Make a copy of the
067   * buffer to ensure that the position, limit, and mark of the original are not
068   * affect by this.
069   *
070   * @param buffer
071   *          a byte buffer
072   * @return the new item
073   */
074  @NonNull
075  static IHexBinaryItem valueOf(@NonNull ByteBuffer buffer) {
076    return new HexBinaryItem(buffer);
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
081   *
082   * @param item
083   *          the item to cast
084   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
085   *         cast to this type
086   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
087   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
088   */
089  @NonNull
090  static IHexBinaryItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
091    try {
092      return item instanceof IHexBinaryItem
093          ? (IHexBinaryItem) item
094          : valueOf(item.asString());
095    } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
096      // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
097      throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
098    }
099  }
100
101  @Override
102  default IHexBinaryItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
103    return cast(item);
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Compares this value with the argument.
108   *
109   * @param item
110   *          the item to compare with this value
111   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
112   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
113   */
114  default int compareTo(@NonNull IHexBinaryItem item) {
115    return asByteBuffer().compareTo(item.asByteBuffer());
116  }
117}
